newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 26.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Minor typhoone Zane threatens holiday.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Navy sources confirm live-fire exercise off Taiwan's east coast.
Probes of organised crime target several high level legislators.
CENTRAL DAILY NEWS - U.S. House of Representatives passes resolution to support Taiwan's bid for U.N. membership.
Public Health Agency sends delegation to U.S. for discussion of dispute over market access for medical equipment imports.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taipei mayor vows to plug tax loopholes of enterprises controlled by organised crime groups.
Finance Ministry expects Taiwan futures market to start before October 1997.
